# Healthcare Leadership

This folder catalogs individuals who hold senior medical and administrative leadership roles within the Danish regional healthcare system and its clinical quality programs. The pages here document medical directors and management representatives who anchor national initiatives—such as the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB)—within cross-regional governance structures, providing the necessary political and organizational backing for clinical registries.

## Pages

- [[lone-winther-jensen|Lone Winther Jensen]] — Medical director and management representative for the Regional Health Directors' Circle, serving on the AKDB steering committee to ensure regional and political backing.
